statement_en: Show that there are infinitely many pairs (S, T) of disjoint non-empty finite sets of positive integers such that the product of the binomial coefficients C(2m, m) over m ∈ S equals the product of C(2k, k) over k ∈ T.
statement_lean:
-- IMPORTS: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Central
theorem erdos_39851 :
    Set.Infinite {w : Finset ℕ × Finset ℕ |
      Disjoint w.1 w.2 ∧ w.1.Nonempty ∧ w.2.Nonempty ∧
      (∀ m ∈ w.1, 0 < m) ∧ (∀ k ∈ w.2, 0 < k) ∧
      ∏ m ∈ w.1, Nat.centralBinom m = ∏ k ∈ w.2, Nat.centralBinom k} := by
  sorry
